gap: No result ChatGPT got states Tesla's own names for the Wall Connector access settings: 'All Vehicles' is the default, 'Only Teslas' and 'Authorized Teslas Only' (Teslas added by VIN) block other cars, and there is a 'Compatibility Mode' for faults with older vehicles. So a J1772 car that won't charge at a destination charger may be stopped by how the host set up the charger, and none of the adapter makers' pages claims to get around that.
standout_why: Compared against thechargecurve.com (Can a Tesla Wall Connector Charge a Non-Tesla EV?), evandcharger.com (Best NACS to J1772 Adapters), electrifiedexperts.com (NACS to J1772 Adapter guide) and the TeslaTap Mini 60 maker page that ChatGPT cited. None of them names the access-control modes or Compatibility Mode. evandcharger and electrifiedexperts don't mention the Rivian/RAV4 oversized ground pin. thechargecurve says it doesn't cover access control at all. ChatGPT's own answer said only that 'some Tesla Destination Chargers are configured for Tesla-only access', so rivals have part of this. I couldn't open the cited thisWATT pages (TLS certificate error), so they may have something I didn't see.
decides: This confirms the pick rather than changing it. Every candidate's maker page names the same Tesla chargers (Destination, Wall Connector, Mobile Connector) and rules out Superchargers. No adapter can override a host's 'Only Teslas' setting, so the page should tell shoppers to ask the host for 'All Vehicles', or for Compatibility Mode if the car faults. The fit facts that actually separate the adapters are vehicle-specific. TeslaTap says its Mini 60 and Mini 80 now fit Rivian and RAV4 EVs with an oversized ground pin. Lectron's 80A page claims 'all J1772 EVs' but doesn't mention ground-pin fit. That points Rivian and RAV4 EV owners toward TeslaTap. Lectron's 80A price today is $129.99, not the $149.99 ChatGPT showed.

findings.label: Tesla Wall Connector access-control modes
findings.value: All Vehicles (default: 'any vehicle can charge'); Only Teslas ('any Tesla can charge'); Authorized Teslas Only ('only Teslas configured in device setup or Tesla app can charge'; you add each car by VIN)
findings.source_title: Optional: Access Controls (Tesla Energy Library, Tesla One commissioning)
findings.note: Tesla's commissioning doc. Under either restricted mode a non-Tesla car can't charge, with or without an adapter. The page doesn't name the Wall Connector generation or a firmware version.

findings.label: Wall Connector Compatibility Mode
findings.value: 'This option allows Wall Connector to be compatible with older generation vehicles … Use it only if you experience faults with your Wall Connector and your electric vehicle.'
findings.source_title: Optional: Access Controls (Tesla Energy Library, Universal Wall Connector install, Commissioning Procedure)
findings.note: Listed as a fourth option next to All Vehicles, Only Teslas and Authorized Teslas Only in the Universal Wall Connector install docs. The host sets it, not the driver.
